source_review.use_summary: Uses the Bioconductor R package velociraptor to call scVelo for organoid RNA-velocity analysis; reported latent-time comparisons belong to the underlying scVelo result context.
uncertainties: The scVelo edition, velociraptor edition, velocity mode, runtime and exact latent-time call/settings are unreported.
Preserve the R wrapper, data conversion and environment requirements separately from direct Python scVelo execution.
The text names Velocyto but attaches a velociraptor Bioconductor URL; preserve this source/link discrepancy instead of silently relabeling the generating tool.
Latent time and neuronal-maturation conclusions are reported results; no direction, causal validity or paper reproduction is established by a synthetic example.

supporting_evidence.section: Material and methods / snRNA-seq and data analysis

related_underlying_scvelo_results.section: Results / del(17)p11.2 alters the expression of genes associated with cell cycle, neurodevelopment, and synapse assembly in SMS hiPSC-derived cortical organoids

source_review.implementation_scope_note: Selected original velociraptor1.20.0 Linux/WSL trusted-R-script workflow with original R preprocessing, all7 S4 signatures, SingleCellExperiment/AnnData conversion and declared scvelo0.3.3 backend. Exact tested profile: R4.5.3,Python3.12.10,NumPy2.2.6,Pandas2.2.3,SciPy1.16.3; not a recovered author environment. Separate R-only figures use complete supplied fits/projections without a Python fitting backend.13 complete numeric original comparisons,4 complete original figure pairs/8 graph replays,2 matching original errors,36 controls and6 complete examples validate selected integration paths, not the entire package, paper results, biological interpretation or convergence. Unknown author editions, mode, calls and the Velocyto-name/velociraptor-URL discrepancy remain unchanged. The native Java grid component calculates neither RNA velocity nor latent time and adds no second family credit. Original native R stack diagnostics remain unresolved; review complete raw consoles and conditions and keep unknown totals unavailable. SKIP3 skips dependent analysis for missing/forbidden prerequisites or execution. FAIL2 admits no complete result, including recording failures. Preserve original/partial objects, literal identifiers and NA/NaN/Inf; correct the named cause and retry NEW paths without changing saved hashes. Four historical direct-Python scVelo SVGs remain irrecoverable.
